0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, first in the Northwest and second in the West) host the Phoenix Suns (1-1, eighth in the West and 1.5 games back in the Pacific) in the Thunder's fourth game of the season, and they are riding a three-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and swept the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 131-122 win in Phoenix on April 27, 2026. Oklahoma City is missing Jalen Williams (ankle), Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), and Cason Wallace (shoulder) and Jaylin Williams (wrist soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
